jobs.title: Technology-Driven Fixed Income Investing for Insurers
jobs.description: Fixed Income Investing for Insurers | bondIT Solutions Technology-Driven Fixed Income Investing for Insurers Scalable Fixed Income Solutions for Wealth Managers Integrated Fixed Income Technology for Financial Institutions In-Sourcing Fixed Income for Asset Owners Automating Fixed Income for Asset & Portfolio Managers Our Products News & Resources Company Careers Contact Login Book a Demo Solutions Technology-Driven Fixed Income Investing for Insurers Insurers face unique challenges when it comes to investing, including the need to balance risk and return while complying with complex regulatory constraints. In today’s dynamic financial landscape, optimizing bond allocation and effectively managing credit risk are more important than ever. bondIT helps insurers to minimise credit risk and translate risk and return requirements into optimal portfolios, considering specific constraints. bondIT helps insurers minimize credit risk and turn risk and return requirements into optimal portfolios under specific constraints. Frontier builds and rebalances portfolios in minutes rather than days, solving regulatory limits, rating buckets, sector caps and duration targets inside the same optimization. When constraints cannot all be met at once, the solve-anyway function returns the closest feasible portfolio and shows which constraints were relaxed – an audit trail rather than a black box. Our platform provides insurers with the tools needed to make informed investment decisions, enabling them to achieve their financial objectives while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements. Whether it’s navigating market volatility or adjusting to new regulations, bondIT ensures that your investment strategy remains robust and resilient. Match cash flows with custom bond ladders Construct ladders with staggered maturities that deliver a defined cash flow schedule against expected liabilities. Maturity structure is solved together with yield, credit quality and regulatory constraints in a single optimization, rather than laddering first and checking constraints afterwards. How does Scorable anticipate credit rating changes? Scorable analyses 250+ variables daily across roughly 3,000 rated corporate and financial issuers, processing 350 GB of data per day, and forecasts rating transition probabilities over a 12-month horizon. It anticipated 90.2% of downgrades versus 79% indicated by rating agency outlooks, and 78.2% of upgrades versus 54.7%. Downgrade signals have correlated with roughly 35% CDS spread widening over the following year. Explainable by design Every Scorable score exposes its drivers, so portfolio managers and risk committees can see why a risk assessment moved. The Alerts Engine lets analysts define criteria — changes in downgrade or upgrade probability, relative value classification, external ratings — and receive daily updates. Scorable is deployed as an independent lens alongside internal credit models, not as a replacement. bondIT is data-agnostic, API-first and SOC 2 certified, integrating with existing internal models, portfolio management and execution systems. Find Out More Case Study bondIT & Ampega “Thanks to the signals that Scorable generates, changes in credit risk can be identified at an early stage. This enables our portfolio managers to derive recommendations for action and carry out timely portfolio reallocations”. Stefan Kopf Head of Fixed Income at Ampega Asset Management. Ampega Asset Management has been a collaboration partner and early adopter of Scorable’s credit analytics. They were looking for a solution to help them better understand and anticipate credit risk, one of the major challenges in today’s fixed income world. Ampega is responsible for the assets held by Talanx, a major European insurance group whose brands include HDI and Hannover Re, and has currently €160 billion assets under management. Scorable’s Rating Transition Signals complement Ampega’s credit watchlist process, helping the asset manager identify anomalies and the associated price fluctuations at individual issuer level ahead of the market. Scorable’s Explainable-AI approach is of major importance to Ampega, because it creates transparency and enables the portfolio managers to easily track and understand the model information as well as the drivers behind changes in the risk score of individual issuers. Another important feature is Scorable’s Alerts Engine, which allows the analysts to define relevant criteria, including changes in downgrade or upgrade probability, relative value classifications or external ratings, and receive daily updates on changes straight to their inbox. Clients often have multiple portfolios, each with unique individual preferences, return targets, risk tolerances, cash flow needs, liquidity constraints, and ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) objectives. This complexity demands a more sophisticated approach. The Challenge of Customization In today’s competitive landscape, providing personalized investment solutions is crucial for superior client engagement. However, the traditional manual process of creating tailored portfolio recommendations can overwhelm resources, limiting your ability to scale and efficiently manage client demands. How can wealth management businesses overcome these hurdles to deliver exceptional service without sacrificing efficiency? bondIT enables wealth managers to mass customize solutions, enhance the client experience and efficiently tailor portfolios to their clients' specific needs and objectives Enter bondIT: Smart Technology for Superior Portfolio Management bondIT Frontier gives wealth managers the tools to mass customize fixed income solutions. Portfolio creation moves from weeks or days to minutes, and clients report that work which took hours now takes minutes. The separately managed account market is projected at $3.6 trillion in 2026, and Frontier is built to service that scale without adding headcount in proportion. SMA and model management: apply one constraint set across many similar accounts at once, with batch rebalancing and post-trade allocation, so hundreds of personalized portfolios are managed without a matching increase in headcount. In-meeting proposals: generate a bespoke proposal in seconds, compare it side by side with the current portfolio, and hand the client a plain-language summary of yield, risk, duration and exposure written by Portfolio Summary with AI. Credit-aware rebalancing: Scorable forecasts rating transitions across roughly 3,000 rated corporate and financial issuers, so you can reduce exposure to deteriorating credits and switch into higher-quality bonds at comparable or better yield. BondWise, built on bondIT Frontier/Embedded, has run on BNY Pershing’s advisor workstation since 2023 and serves 150+ broker-dealer and RIA firms, which have executed several billion dollars in trades through it.
